title: Componentwise sequence coefficient pullback comparison
statement: Let ell be prime, E a finite extension of Q_ell, f:X→Y any scheme map, and U an object of the sequence site of X. The component of ringMap ell E f none at U is an isomorphism.

source.place: Tags 03CB and 0941, finite-stage comparison evaluated at a product-site object.

proof.text: Write U=(n,V). Evaluate the sequence-site adjunction at U. The resulting component is the finite-stage coefficient comparison at index n, transported along the product projection. Apply the finite-stage inverse and use compatibility with quotient transition maps to check the two inverse equations componentwise.

proof_origin.place: Finite-stage comparison evaluated on each sequence-site object.

lean.statement: theorem coefficientPullback_none_isIso_app {X Y : Scheme.{t}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (U : Site X none) : IsIso ((ringMap ell E f none).hom.app (op U))
